title: Wash-Sale Window Guard
description: Deterministic wash-sale window arithmetic over caller-declared synthetic inputs: the declared 61-day acquisition window (sale date minus 30 days through sale date plus 30 days, inclusive) is applied to a declared lot sale and a declared replacement-purchase list; the node totals the disallowed loss at 2dp half-up, flags a replacement account declared tax-deferred inside the window, and raises a basis-carryforward flag on the flagged taxable path. Arithmetic of a named rule only — never advice, never an optimizer. Zero storage, zero network, no runtime clock.

sale_date.description: Declared sale date, ISO yyyy-mm-dd; an undated lot fails closed.

realized_loss.description: Declared realized loss on the lot; finite, non-negative.

replacement_purchases.description: Declared replacement purchases; may be empty. Each entry carries a date and an account_type; an undated entry fails closed.

account_type.description: Declared account type of the replacement purchase.

window_start.description: Sale date minus 30 days, ISO yyyy-mm-dd; window endpoint is inclusive.

window_end.description: Sale date plus 30 days, ISO yyyy-mm-dd; window endpoint is inclusive.

replacements_in_window.description: Count of declared replacement purchases with dates inside the inclusive 61-day window.

disallowed_loss.description: The declared realized loss rounded 2dp half-up when the window is non-empty, otherwise 0.

ira_trap.description: True when an in-window replacement purchase is declared in a tax-deferred account.

trace.description: Human-readable restatement of the declared arithmetic.

overall.description: Sign-of-arithmetic verdict over the declared window arithmetic only.

warnings.description: Conditional warning flags mirrored into the payload; present only when one fired (WSG_IRA_TRAP).

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_wash_sale_window_guard
mcp_tool_definition.description: Applies the declared 61-day wash-sale window (sale date plus or minus 30 days, inclusive) to a declared lot sale and a declared replacement-purchase list: totals the disallowed loss, flags a replacement account declared tax-deferred, and raises a basis-carryforward flag on the flagged taxable path; arithmetic of a named rule only, never advice.

sale.description: declared lot sale with lot_id, sale_date, realized_loss

replacement_purchases.description: declared replacement purchases, each with date and account_type
